<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>verify-work-proportionally</code></p>

Match verification layers to impact and uncertainty, then separate proven behavior from assumptions and acceptance gaps.

## When to use

Match verification layers to impact, uncertainty, reversibility, and audience when tests alone cannot prove the requested outcome or acceptance boundary.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link verify-work-proportionally --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link verify-work-proportionally --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Learning outcomes

- Map material risks to static, automated, live, independent, or user verification.
- Separate verified behavior from plans, assumptions, and unverified acceptance.

## Examples

### Verify a risky implementation

**Prompt**

> Use the verify-work-proportionally skill to choose and run appropriate checks for this cross-cutting implementation.

**Expected outcome**

Each material risk has an observable check and the final report states exact verified coverage.

### Decide whether user approval is needed

**Prompt**

> Use the verify-work-proportionally skill to determine which remaining acceptance points require the user's judgment.

**Expected outcome**

Only irreducible product, taste, privacy, or authorization decisions are returned to the user.
